title: se-implementation-scratchpad-summit-trust-bank
content:
Context: kickoff with Summit Trust (regional bank) on 11/06. Customer wants private deployment in AWS GovCloud-eqv, VPC peering to their transit VPC, strict IP allowlists, KMS integration for model keys, and dedicated capacity for peak hours (9am-5pm ET). They currently target ~150 QPS for embeddings workload and up to 30 concurrent text-generation sessions (chat).

High-level requirements / constraints:
- Private control plane with minimal public exposure (customer-managed VPC peering via AWS Transit Gateway)
- KMS integration: customer will provide CMK ARN; must support envelope encryption for KV cache and logs
- Compliance: audit logs retained 1 year, syslog export to their S3 (GovCloud) + optional SIEM connector
- SLA target: p99 latency < 250ms for embeddings (128-dim batch size typical), p95 < 500ms for chat generation (max tokens 256)
- Cost: they'd prefer autoscaling with reserved min capacity so baseline cost predictable (monthly commit for Dedicated)

Current plan (architecture notes):
- Deploy Redwood Private control plane in customer account (GovCloud) with private endpoint; nodes in 3 AZs in us-gov-west-1 equivalent
- Dedicated GPU pool: 8x A10G equiv (or 4x A100-40 if customer approves slightly higher cost for better perf). Start with A10G equiv for cost.
- Network: TGW attachment -> customer transit VPC. Set up route tables + NACLs per security checklist.
- Auth: OIDC SSO to their Okta tenant for console access; API access via mTLS for infra endpoints + API keys for app-level requests; require IP allowlist for management plane.
- KMS: use customer CMK ARN; establish key policy allowing Redwood service principal in their account (doc to send to security)

Config / implementation checklist (action items):
- [ ] Draft network diagram for customer review (owner: Jordan) -- due 2024-11-15
- [ ] Prepare key-policy template for customer CMK and send to security (owner: Priya) -- due 2024-11-12
- [ ] Create initial infra repo branch for summit-trust (repo: infra/summit-trust) (owner: Ethan) -- due 2024-11-14
- [ ] Estimate cost for two capacity profiles: (A) 8x A10G baseline + autoscale + burst; (B) 4x A100-40 baseline -- include monthly commit numbers (owner: Jordan) -- due 2024-11-18
- [ ] Draft S3 export workflow and lambda for log shipping to customer S3 (owner: Ethan) -- due 2024-11-20
- [ ] Security review scheduled with customer (Priya) -- meeting 2024-11-22

Runtime tuning notes (initial):
- Embeddings workload: use batch size 64, prefix caching enabled for repeated customer vectors.
- Generation workload: set dynamic batching with max_batch_latency=12ms to keep p95 under target; keep max_batch_tokens=2048.
- KV cache eviction: LRU with hot-key replication across nodes in pool to reduce cross-AZ traffic.
- Quantization: start with int8 for embeddings model; hold off for generation model until quality evals pass.

Testing / evals:
- Need prompt set for chat SLOs (customer-provided 50 canonical prompts). Add to eval harness: eval-run SE-2143-prompts
- Regression detection: baseline before upgrade; store artifacts in confluence page linked above

Customer contacts / notes:
- Primary: Claire Montgomery (Summit Trust) -- email claire.m@summittrust.example, security lead: Robert Li
- Timezone: ET; prefers calls 10am-2pm ET
- Notes from kickoff: worried about data residency; emphasize GovCloud-only storage and no model logs leaving region

Open questions / TODO for follow-up:
- Confirm whether they want per-tenant model version pinning (can add but has complexity for storage/eviction)
- Need legal to confirm transfer of audit logs to customer-managed S3 is OK under our SOC2 terms (Priya to flag)
- Verify if customer requires HSM-backed CMK (they asked about HSM in kickoff) -- if yes, schedule deeper KMS design

Quick commands / snippets to keep handy:
- Terraform workspace template: terraform workspace new summit-trust; use var.region = "us-gov-west-1"
- KMS policy snippet (to send):
  - "Statement": [{ "Effect": "Allow", "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REDWOOD_SERVICE_PRINCIPAL"}, "Action": "kms:Encrypt" }]

Notes to self (incomplete thoughts):
- If customer's traffic pattern is heavy during business hours and near-zero nights, consider schedule-based autoscaling to save cost. Could pre-warm nodes at 8:30am ET to avoid cold-start latency for first 30 mins.
- Might be worth proposing a hybrid: Dedicated baseline for chat, but hosted API for non-sensitive embeddings (if they relax residency) -- optional upsell path.

References:
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SE/Summit+Trust+Onboarding
- Jira: JIRA-SE-2143 (implementation epic)
- Infra PR placeholder: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/438

Last sync notes (2024-11-08): Claire asked for a simple one-page checklist for their CISOs. Create a one-pager and attach to onboarding packet.
summary: SE scratchpad for Summit Trust onboarding: private/GovCloud deployment, VPC peering, KMS, dedicated capacity. Action items, runtime tuning, testing plan, open questions.
